title: Batman: Haunted Knight (DC Comics, 2018) – Jeph Loeb & Tim Sale
descriptionText:
Condition: Excellent — minimal shelf wear, tight binding, and clean pages (see photos).
Description:
From the Eisner Award–winning team Jeph Loeb and Tim Sale (Batman: The Long Halloween, Batman: Dark Victory), Batman: Haunted Knight collects three chilling Halloween-themed tales from Legends of the Dark Knight. Each story delves into Gotham’s darker corners, exploring fear, madness, and redemption through haunting visuals and masterful storytelling.
Before The Long Halloween, there was Haunted Knight — the series that set the tone for Batman’s modern noir legacy.
Details:
Title: Batman: Haunted Knight
Publisher: DC Comics
Publication Year: 2018 (First Printing)
Writers: Jeph Loeb
Artist: Tim Sale
Colorist: Gregory Wright
Letterer: Todd Klein
ISBN: 978-1-4012-8486-2
Cover Price: $19.99 USD / $25.99 CAD
Collects:
Batman: Legends of the Dark Knight Halloween Special #1 (Fears)
Batman: Madness – A Legends of the Dark Knight Halloween Special
Batman: Ghosts – A Legends of the Dark Knight Halloween Special
Special Notes:
Features stunning black, orange, and blue cover art by Tim Sale
Includes story introductions inspired by Alice in Wonderland and A Christmas Carol
Dedicated to editor Archie Goodwin
Condition Notes: Excellent — light shelf wear only (see all photos for details). No creases, markings, or tears.
